card.name: PubMed ID numbers in citations
card.fires_on: The colon or the individual digits of a PubMed ID (PMID) number in a reference citation or PubMed link.

modes.label: Colon after PMID
modes.description: The colon right after the letters PMID, before the number starts.

modes.label: Digits inside the ID
modes.description: A single digit within a long PubMed ID number, often the first or a middle digit.
modes.example: PMID: 20096<<7>>92 Image courtesy of Elizabeth Red

card.plain: It lights up on the digits of the PubMed ID numbers that appear in reference lists and links.
